name.en-US: A Mystery Play in Honour of the Nativity of Our Lord
name.pt-BR: Um Mistério em Honra da Natividade de Nosso Senhor

description.en-US: Benson's mystery play of 1908 for Christmas, in the manner of the medieval cycles, written for performance at Cambridge: a preface, five scenes of the Nativity, and appendices on the scenery, properties, costumes and method of acting.
description.pt-BR: O mistério de Natal de Benson (1908), ao modo dos ciclos medievais, escrito para ser representado em Cambridge: um prefácio, cinco cenas da Natividade e apêndices sobre cenário, objetos, trajes e modo de representar.

sources.edition: A Mystery Play in Honour of the Nativity of Our Lord (London: Longmans, Green, 1908), Project Gutenberg #61606, proofread.
sources.description: Gutenberg licence and transcriber notes are dropped. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1908, so the text is public domain.
